title: Record the reconciled first-unit learning contract
description:
## Work

Reconcile the source and linguistic audits into a coverage contract before prose. Assign all selected Cook items with original IDs and exact prompts, account for audited alternatives, define full paradigm teaching and syntax, register all added tasks/examples and reading segments, and give each required form/sense/construction a justified status. Record editorial decisions and remaining limitations.

Role: coordinator

- chapters/ch01/coverage.json
- chapters/ch01/editorial-notes.md

Concrete coverage.json prepared before prose; every planned item and paradigm supported; no independent production relies on supplied/unresolved knowledge; active source crosswalk and key IDs planned.

title: Refine the full-paradigm course sequence
description:
## Work

Group whole declensions and clearly defined verbal paradigms with their ordinary syntactic uses, enough early verb teaching for connected readings, cumulative review, and unrestricted need-based vocabulary. Start from zero taught knowledge. Exercises 1–3 are a first-unit candidate; exact later source allocation awaits reconciliation. Do not draft learner chapters or change shared maps/registers.

## Ownership

Role: curriculum-analyst

## Acceptance Criteria

Proposed contents with each unit's paradigm scope, syntactic prerequisites, reading progression, and explicit substantive open choices; distinction between agreed decisions and recommendations; no unearned prior teaching.
